child.answer: Rellan confirmed the current seal has five points. Keep the ward.
child.memory: Orders of the Dead: the copied royal seal had seven points; the current seal has five.
child.name: The borrowed captain
child.question: Rellan’s image orders you to surrender the counter-ward: “The royal seven-point seal proves my command.” The apparition casts no shadow across a lit floor.
child.spirit: Your Spirit moves independently of you. The imitation repeats exactly when the apparition repeats: a copied human rhythm.

keeper.answer: Alaric’s signal has three steady lights. Hold the ward and free the memory.
keeper.memory: Alaric admitted following a copied friend’s voice. The agreed signal is three steady lights; no ally will ask you to lower the counter-ward.
keeper.name: The remembered companion
keeper.question: Alaric’s lost companion begs: “Open the inner ward; trust my voice.” The real counter-ward burns in three steady points, while her copied light flickers in only two.
keeper.spirit: Your Spirit refuses the two-beat imitation. Its own movement remains irregular and alive.
keeper.wrong: Open the ward because the voice is familiar.

miner.answer: Dust took Bera’s voice before the bell. This memory is altered.
miner.memory: The Last Shift: Bera could not speak before the bell. Both miners returned to Hesta.
miner.name: The stolen last shift
miner.question: Bera calls: “I rang the bell and shouted Oren to safety.” Her lips repeat a fraction after the echo. An old rescue brace lies beneath the scene.
miner.spirit: The Spirit’s pulse passes through the false Bera, but catches on the real iron brace beneath her.
miner.wrong: Bera called Oren below after the bell.
